name: bspc-monorepo
description: Authorized Crypto Admin Dashboard & DApp Monorepo

scripts.test:unit: vitest run tests/web3.test.ts tests/role-auth.test.ts tests/wallet-auth.test.ts tests/firebase.test.ts tests/wallet-challenge.test.ts tests/admin-boundary.test.ts tests/chat-service.test.ts
scripts.test:rules: npx firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore "vitest run tests/firestore-rules.test.ts"
scripts.test:functions: npx firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions "vitest run tests/functions-integration.test.ts"
scripts.test:chat: npx firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions "vitest run tests/chat-integration.test.ts"
scripts.test:integration: npx firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions "vitest run tests/firestore-rules.test.ts tests/functions-integration.test.ts tests/chat-integration.test.ts"
